subject: Summit AI: proposed indemnity & liability cap for POC — escalation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@summit.ai>, Michael Zhou <m.zhou@summit.ai>, procurement@summit.ai
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Summit AI POC — proposed indemnity & liability cap

Hi Alice / Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Summit's POC scope looks like a good fit. Attached is the SOW we discussed (Summit_SOW_POC.pdf) and our standard MSA with the model/access-specific indemnity carve-out redlined (SummitAI_Redlines_v3.docx).

Two items to call out that are likely to be non-standard for your legal team and that we'd like to confirm before we finalize the SOW:

- Liability cap: for POC work we propose a per-occurrence cap of $250,000 and aggregate cap of $500,000.
- Indemnity: given the use of third-party open models and datasets, we've requested a limited, POC-scoped indemnity rather than broad customer indemnity for model outputs. The redline explicitly limits indemnity to breaches of Redwood's obligations or IP infringement where Redwood had control.

If those two items are blockers on your side we'll need to know so we can talk through options. We're happy to accept additional operational safeguards (SLA credits, insurance proof, limited warranty period) in trade for tighter liability/indemnity language.

Next steps: can you confirm whether your procurement/legal team can accept these POC-scoped terms or whether you need us to route for exec approval?

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@summit.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:04:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit AI POC — proposed indemnity & liability cap

Karthik,

Thanks for sending the docs. We reviewed with procurement & legal. A few quick points:

- $250k/$500k cap is too low for us for any vendor storing our data. We typically require a $5M aggregate cap for vendors handling PII or production customer data.
- The limited indemnity as redlined won't fly for Summit. Our counsel requires standard vendor indemnity (IP, data breach, third-party claims) without carve-outs for model outputs.

We can be flexible on warranty windows for the POC, and we can scope the SOW so only non-production test data is used, but we need legal to reach parity on core liability/indemnity. I'll attach our redline for your reference.

If Redwood needs exec-level concession for the indemnity/cap change, flag it and we can pause the signature until approvals are in place.

-Alice

Vivek / Marissa — forwarding Summit's reply. They are pushing for standard indemnity and a $5M aggregate cap.

Summary: Summit wants parity to their standard vendor terms. They consider a reduced warranty window and POC data scoping as compensating controls.

Ask: 1) Can legal accept a $1M cap (instead of our proposed $250k) for the POC subject to documented scoping & insurance confirmation? 2) Is the indemnity carve-out for model outputs a hard no? If legal deems this material, I need to know if we should request exec approval.

I will hold signing until you advise.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 15:30:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Summit AI POC — proposed indemnity & liability cap (need guidance)

Karthik / Marissa,

Quick read of Summit's redline attached. Bottom line: we can accept a concession for the POC but with firm constraints. Key points:

- Liability cap: Recommend countering at $1,000,000 aggregate for the POC (higher than your ask but significantly below Summit's $5M). Rationale: POC is time-boxed + limited data. Coupled with an insurance certificate requirement (commercial general liability with vendor endorsement) this is reasonable.
- Indemnity: Cannot accept broad customer indemnity that covers model output consequences. We should offer a mutual indemnity for IP infringement and a limited data-breach indemnity tied to Redwoods proven operational controls. For any claim specifically arising from model-generated content, we propose an exceptions carve-out and a requirement that Summit demonstrates damages beyond speculative reputational harm.
- Warranty: Offer a limited warranty for a 30-day period that services will materially conform to the SOW; exclude downstream business loss and punitive damages.

Risk: moderate — Summit is a mid-market customer with strategic potential. If we concede full indemnity or $5M cap we substantially increase tail risk across exposures.

Approval path: I believe the proposed counter (1M cap + limited indemnity + insurance) requires exec approval from Revenue/Legal (aditya_rao). If exec approves, we will send: 1) annotated redline (Legal_annotated_redline.pdf), 2) requirement that Summit provide insurance certificate prior to production access, and 3) a POC data handling appendix limiting dataset types to non-production/test data.

Please see attached annotated redline with in-line rationale.

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Summit AI POC — request exec authorization for liability/indemnity concession

Aditya, Vivek,

Summary: Summit (deal: DEAL-2027-0817) has pushed back on our proposed POC terms. They require standard indemnity language and a $5M aggregate cap. Legal recommends a compromise: 1) Redwood accepts a $1M aggregate cap for the POC only, 2) Redwood retains a limited indemnity carve-out for model outputs (mutual IP indemnity otherwise), 3) Summit must provide insurance certificate (CGL + tech E&O) and agree to a POC data-handling appendix limiting datasets to non-production/test data.

Why approve: Summit is a strategic pilot with clear expansion potential; losing the deal could impact our pipeline in mid-market AI vertical. The compromise reduces legal exposure compared to Summit's request while enabling the pilot. Legal flags this as a higher-than-usual cap but within a controlled POC scope with insurance.

Recommended approval (what I need from you, Aditya):
- One-time exception to approve a $1,000,000 aggregate liability cap for the POC.
- Authorization to accept our proposed limited indemnity (model-output carve-out) in exchange for the insurance + data appendix.

If approved, we will send the annotated redline and require the insurance cert before any environment access. If denied, Karthik will push for Summit to accept our original terms or pause the contract.

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / REQUEST_CHANGES by EOD Fri 5/14.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0199
